## Summary

Brings the package up to current Julia packaging practice and fixes a few bugs found along the way.

### Infrastructure
- Replace Travis CI (no longer free for OSS) with GitHub Actions: tests on Julia 1.10 (LTS) and latest release on Linux, plus latest on macOS and Windows; coverage uploaded to Codecov
- Add CompatHelper and Dependabot (for Actions versions); update TagBot to the current recommended workflow
- Update README badges

### Packaging
- Require Julia 1.10; add compat bounds for `LinearAlgebra`/`SparseArrays`
- Fix `author` → `authors` in `Project.toml`
- Move test dependencies to `[extras]`/`[targets]`; remove `test/Project.toml`
- Stop committing `Manifest.toml` files
- Update JuMP/Ipopt to 1.x; drop the `Distributions` test dependency (only used for `rand(Uniform(0,1))`)
- Add Aqua.jl quality checks

### Bug fixes (each with a regression test)
- `vec2tril(::SparseIterate, p)` used a nonexistent field (`nzval2full`) and always errored
- `At_mul_B_row(A, ::SparseIterate, row)` checked `row` against the wrong dimension, rejecting valid rows on non-square `A`
- `Vector(::SparseIterate)` errored on an empty iterate
- `mul!(C, ::SymmetricSparseIterate, ::AbstractTriangular)` was ambiguous on Julia 1.10 (found by Aqua)

### Test fixes
- `show` tests no longer hard-code Julia's type printing
- `mul!` test compares floats with `≈` instead of `==`

## Testing
Full test suite passes locally on Julia 1.10.12 and 1.13.2.

## Notes
- Version is still 0.3.0; bump before registering a release, since the minimum Julia version changed.
